We\'ll transfer your existing wallet balance and transaction history to your new non-custodial wallet.\n\nPlease don\'t close the app during the upgrade.
Do I have to upgrade my wallet?
Yes. Support for the old custodial wallet will be discontinued on April 30, 2026. All users need to upgrade prior to this date.
Does the new LibreNostr wallet support both lightning and on-chain transactions?
Yes. Just like with the old custodial wallet, the new LibreNostr wallet enables users to send and receive lightning and on-chain bitcoin transactions.
Can I keep my existing LibreNostr lightning address?
Yes. Your LibreNostr lightning address will not change after the wallet upgrade.
Can I transfer my funds to a different wallet before I upgrade?
Yes. The old custodial wallet remains fully functional until April 30, 2026. You can send your funds to any other bitcoin wallet prior to upgrading.
Will I be able to revert to the old custodial wallet after the upgrade?
No. After the wallet upgrade is completed, you will not be able to revert to the old custodial wallet, however your full transaction history will be transferred to the new wallet.
What if I don\'t upgrade before support for the old wallet is discontinued?

After April 30, 2026 the old custodial wallet will no longer be functional. If you don\'t upgrade and still have some funds in that wallet, you will be able to recover them by contacting us at support@nostrich.org.
Which technology is the new LibreNostr wallet built on?
The new LibreNostr wallet is built on the Spark network technology. For more information, you can visit: https://spark.money.
Are there any transaction fees that I need to pay to upgrade?
No. LibreNostr will cover all transaction fees required to upgrade all our users to their new non-custodial wallets.
Does the new wallet support Nostr Wallet Connect?

Yes. The new LibreNostr wallet does support Nostr Wallet Connect, however it works a bit differently than the old one. Since the new wallet is non-custodial, the LibreNostr mobile app needs to be running in order to sign NWC events. The NWC feature is best used in conjunction with the LibreNostr remote signer.
I have existing NWC connections to the old LibreNostr wallet. Will I have to re-create those with the new wallet?
Yes. Old NWC connections will stop working when the old wallet is deprecated on April 30, 2026.
